gloss: day after day; every day; for days on end

definitions.gloss: day after day; every day; for days on end
definitions.explanation: Multiple consecutive days. Emphasizes that something continues happening without interruption over a series of days.

examples.japanese: {連日|れんじつ}{猛暑|もうしょ}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The extreme heat has been continuing day after day.

examples.japanese: {連日|れんじつ}の{残業|ざんぎょう}で{疲|つか}れがたまっている。
examples.english: I'm exhausted from working overtime day after day.

examples.japanese: このニュースは{連日|れんじつ}{報道|ほうどう}されており、{国民|こくみん}の{関心|かんしん}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: This news has been reported on day after day, and public interest is growing.

notes:
A compound of {連|れん} (continuous) + {日|じつ} (day). Used as both a noun and an adverb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連日|れんじつ}{続|つづ}く (to continue day after day)
- {連日|れんじつ}の{猛暑|もうしょ} (consecutive days of extreme heat)
- {連日|れんじつ}{報道|ほうどう}される (to be reported on daily)
- {連日|れんじつ}{満員|まんいん} (full house every day)
- {連日|れんじつ}の{疲|つか}れ (exhaustion from consecutive days)

Common in weather reports and news. Similar to {毎日|まいにち} (every day) but emphasizes that something has been continuous and ongoing, often with a nuance of persistence or endurance.
